name: Letterpress
summary: Printing from raised metal or wood type and blocks, locked in a forme and pressed into the paper.
how: Set the type by hand from a case, letter by letter, and justify each line with spaces in the composing stick.
Lock the type, the rules and the blocks in a chase, ink the forme with rollers and press it into the sheet.
Dampen a soft rag paper so that the type bites 0.1–0.3 mm into it.
Print each ink from a separate forme or a separate pull, and register them by pins or lays.

origin.note: Johannes Gutenberg prints the 42-line Bible from cast metal type in a screw press.

adoptions.via: Poster printers set large wood letters in the same press as metal type and print show bills by the hundred.
William Morris returns to the hand press, handmade paper and a heavy cast type at the Kelmscott Press.
Newspaper comics print from line plates and type on rotary letterpress, with Ben-Day tints on the colour plates.
